findings.title: OCI snapshots ignore tenant/user/namespace identity
findings.rationale: OCI artifacts and resource cleanup bind canonical workspace/state directory, tenant/user/namespace and run identity. The public runHarness cross-scope disclosure reproduction now fails to disclose another scope candidate; isolation and lifecycle regressions pass.
findings.owner: Zhivex Harness maintainers (remediation in merged PR #77)

findings.title: Concurrent approved writes both pass the same digest precondition
findings.rationale: Cross-process cooperative mutation locking serializes digest checks and publication; concurrent writers admit exactly one conflicting change. Process-death and OCI import regressions pass. External non-Harness writers remain outside the protocol.
findings.owner: Zhivex Harness maintainers (remediation in merged PR #77)

findings.title: Replacement approval hides replacement text in its default card
findings.rationale: Default replacement approval renders the full old/new text and digest with terminal escaping. The long-oldText adversarial marker and rendering regressions pass.
findings.owner: Zhivex Harness maintainers (remediation in merged PR #77)

findings.title: Formal authority inventory omits read_task and repair_plan
findings.rationale: The authority inventory includes read_task and repair_plan and is checked against the actual tool catalog. Coverage contains all 31 current tool classes.
findings.owner: Zhivex Harness maintainers (remediation in merged PR #77)
